title: add vpc control plane terraform: multi-az subnets, interface endpoints, sgs, peering, route53
author: Sofia Martinez
description:
Motivation: Private deployments require a repeatable, auditable Terraform module to provision the VPC control plane (subnets, interface endpoints, security groups, cross-account peering, Route53 private hosted zones and delegation). This PR introduces a production-ready module with multi-AZ defaults, optional cross-account peering and route53 delegation helpers.

What this change does (single paragraph): Adds a new top-level Terraform module 'vpc-control-plane' + examples/terraform/ for private installer usage; introduces interface endpoint support (S3, STS, ECR, KMS, EC2) and corresponding security groups; implements cross-account VPC peering workflow (acceptor and requester roles) with IAM role hooks for automation; optional Route53 delegation + private hosted zone creation and conditional peering-recursor records; updates helm chart values documentation to include control-plane endpoints for private installer.

Checklist: 
- [x] Terraform module scaffold + variables + outputs
- [x] Multi-AZ subnet mapping & defaults
- [x] Interface endpoint resources + endpoint policy examples
- [x] Security groups with least-privilege ingress/egress for control-plane components
- [x] Cross-account peering support (+ acceptance module)
- [x] Route53 private zone + delegation helpers
- [x] Terratest for basic provisioning smoke test (local)
- [x] Docs: README + upgrade notes for private installer
- [x] Changelog entry under 'private'

Notes on backwards compatibility and migrations: Module is additive. Existing private-installer users can adopt by swapping in the module and mapping variables; we provide an upgrade hook script for cluster-admins to create required SG rules and endpoint policies in-place. No breaking changes expected to consumer APIs.

Related work: Linear ENG-1523 (Private installer VPC automation), ENG-1981 (Route53 delegation for private control plane). See SUP-543 for customer support case that motivated cross-account peering flow.

Testing and CI: Added terratest that runs in CI using a small ephemeral AWS account. Initial run surfaced missing aws_eip permissions — fixed in commit 4. Full CI run now passes apart from a flaky acceptance test that was quarantined with a comment and issue link.

Merge strategy: squash merge. Post-merge: publish module to internal registry and cut a patch for private-installer helm values docs.
